steps.command: mkdir -p out && echo 'firmware source prepared' > out/source.txt && cat out/source.txt
echo 'compiling firmware...' && sleep 0.5 && echo 'build ok' > out/build.txt
echo 'running unit tests...' && test -f out/build.txt && echo 'all tests passed'
echo 'packaging artifact...' && tar -czf out/firmware.tar.gz -C out build.txt source.txt && ls -l out
